# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and domestic helper to Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta is a small, young girl with little brown hands who wears a white dress stiffly starched for special occasions. Her hair is plaited into two tails adorned with bright blue ribbon bows tied to stand out like wings from her neck.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045), [v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a faithful, loyal, and warm-hearted young servant who cares deeply for her mistress. She possesses a literal mind, free of cynicism toward imaginative ideas, and obeys instructions dutifully. She is prone to worry, express open concern, and react with dramatic distress when things go wrong.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016)_

- Faithful and loyal  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- Literal-minded  <sub>[v2 c28 P50](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0050), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053)</sub>
- Worry-prone and pessimistic  <sub>[v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016), [v2 c30 P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- Blowing a tin horn to evoke echo responses  <sub>[v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve, protect, and care for Miss Lavendar Lewis  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c27 P55](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0055)</sub>
- To emulate Anne Shirley's mannerisms and poise  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050), [v2 c30 P28](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0028)</sub>

## History

Leonora Bowman comes to live with Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge to provide companionship and domestic help in exchange for board and clothes. She is given the nickname Charlotta the Fourth by her mistress, following in the footsteps of her elder sisters who previously held the role before moving away to Boston. During a visit by Anne Shirley and Diana Barry, Charlotta demonstrates the stone house's famous echoes by blowing a tin horn and laughing loudly for them. She forms a deep admiration for Anne Shirley, eagerly practicing before her mirror to copy Anne's walk and chin tilt. When Miss Lavendar grows withdrawn, Charlotta confides her worries to Anne and helps arrange visits to cheer up her mistress. She later assists enthusiastically with the preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding to Stephen Irving, fussing over minor mishaps and worrying about the weather before dressing in her finest clothes for the ceremony.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Real name is Leonora Bowman, daughter in the Bowman family  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Youngest of the Bowman sisters who served Miss Lavendar following her sisters Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Dubbed 'Charlotta the Fourth' by Miss Lavendar to keep her sisters distinct in thought  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
